**Finding submitted: INDEMN — missing (critical).**

The Agreement has no indemnity, defence or hold-harmless provision anywhere. I verified this by reading every section (Sections 1–10 plus preamble and signature block) and by targeted searches for indemnity, infringement and liability language — the only liability references are in the "No Joint Venture" clause, and Section 9 (Warranties) is limited to corporate-authority representations and the Globix carve-out. That is walk-away territory: no HDI IP indemnity at all.

Cure (preferred level, single insertion at the end of Section 9 as new paragraph (c), so it falls inside the section that already survives under 10.7 without renumbering):
- HDI defends, indemnifies and holds harmless the Company **and its affiliates** against third-party claims for (1) IP infringement/misappropriation by the Site or Services, (2) HDI's breach of applicable law, (3) unauthorised access to or disclosure of Content or user information caused by HDI, and (4) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct;
- standard procedure: prompt written notice, HDI control of defence and settlement, reasonable cooperation;
- our reciprocal indemnity kept narrow — only Company-provided Content and the Company's breach of applicable law.

I avoided the fallback because its super-cap (3× annual fees) and Customer-modification/combination/specification carve-outs would cap HDI's exposure without any offsetting benefit, and the fee structure here is a Net Sales percentage rather than annual fees.
